Workout Progress Badge
The small circle on Dashboard and Log that fills up as you log exercises today, out of a goal of 7. Tap it anytime to see today's full summary.
Rest Timer
Sound when rest ends A louder, sharper double-chime, run through a limiter so it can be pushed loud without distorting
Vibrate when rest ends A strong buzz pattern - the most reliable alert when music is playing, since it doesn't compete with volume at all
Keep screen awake while resting Stops the screen from auto-locking during a rest countdown, so the sound/vibration can actually fire
Notifications
Workout reminders Daily reminder based on your schedule
Streak alerts Reminder when your streak is about to break
PR celebrations Celebrate when you hit a personal record
Notifications are not yet supported in web apps on iOS. Full notification support is coming in a future native app update. These toggles will activate once that's available.
Fitness Goals
Tap once to set as primary goal. Tap any other to add as secondary. Tap again to remove.
Weight History
Tap an entry's delete icon to remove it. Log new weigh-ins from the Profile page (tap the icon in the top right of Dashboard).
Mode
Primary Color
Custom color
Sets the background gradient. Text and card contrast adjust automatically to stay readable in both modes.
Accent Color
Custom color
Highlights the quick-start button and other key moments.
Training Split
Tap a weekday to choose which day-type(s) happen that day. Pick more than one to double up. Switching splits never deletes logged history for any day-type.
Edit Exercises
Tap a name to rename it (history follows the rename). Use the arrows to reorder. Removing an exercise hides it from the list but keeps its logged history safe.
Backup & Restore
Export copies everything: sets, exercise lists, weekly history, to text. Paste it into Notes or email it to yourself. Import restores from a saved backup.
